label: early original-phase step after a sequence prefix built from {g,x,y,w,q,1} then m/z (diffuse token conjunction)
explanation: Very sparse (0.014% of steps). 93% of mass is in the original phase at t=2-6 (peak t=3); it never fires at t=0-1 or after recall_idx 1. Activity is enriched for current input o/1/m, previous input m (17.6x) or z, inputs two back of m/1/q/w, and first tokens g/1/x/y/w/q. It also fires weakly on the first copy step when the sequence begins g w/g y. It looks like a specific direction in hidden state that depends on the identities of the first few tokens, not one readable rule. Single-token predicates have precision under 1%, and the best conjunction reaches F1 about 0.13 (precision 8%, recall 51%) on dev. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.116, max 0.235), and the largest values are on o or m right after g w m or g 1 m prefixes.
